Moḍhapurāṇa
or Dharmāraṇyamāhātmya or Dharmāraṇyopākhyāna. from the Skanda Purāṇa. See under respective titles.
Pt.. with Guj. meaning an. transl. by Vaidya Manekarama Durlabharama Sastri, Gujarat Printing Press, Ahmedabad, Aurangabad, 1914.
See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p.. 759. 1625.

Moḍhaprakāśa
kāvya. in 35 chs. by Yadupati son of Trilocana an. grandson of [Page196-b] Muralidhara an. disciple of Ratnapati of Moḍha family. Alph. list Beng. Govt. 1811 p. 92 (no. 1361). RASB. IV. 3104.

Moḍhavarṇana
or Moḍhadvijavivāhavarṇana.
--by Someśvara Nāgara. RORI. XII. 622. Udaipur p. 114 (no. 869) of Pt.. Cat.
